blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Open-world object detectors aim to localize objects of classes not covered by their training annotations, but most label them only as "unknown". This label tells a system that an object is present but not what it is, while its broader category would allow a more informed decision. We therefore address both uncovering unknown objects and assigning them to the broader categories of a given class taxonomy. For uncovering, we find that most unknown objects are already localized and labeled "unknown" in our base detector, but are discarded during final top-k selection because background receives higher scores. To mitigate this, we propose a class-agnostic ranker that estimates how well each predicted box fits an object and uses these scores to select the final predictions. Across three benchmarks, our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection. For categorizing, we draw on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a category contains the regions of its members. Our categorizer builds each category's region from the known classes and learns how much room to leave for members it has never seen. On the same detections, it categorizes unknown objects more accurately than existing hierarchical methods. Code is available at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.
blocks.zh: 开放世界物体探测器旨在将未被其训练说明所覆盖的班级对象本地化,但大多数只将其贴上"未知"的标签. 这个标签告诉一个系统,一个物体是存在的,但不是它是什么,而其更广泛的类别将允许一个更知情的决定. 因此,我们既要处理发现未知物体的问题,又要把它们归入某一类分类的更广泛类别。 为了发现,我们发现大多数未知物体已经本地化,并在我们的地基探测器中被标记为"未知",但在最后的上克选择中被丢弃,因为背景得到的分数较高. 为了缓解这种情况,我们建议采用一种不可知级的分级法,用以估计每个预测的盒子是否适合一个对象,并利用这些分数来选择最终的预测. 从三个基准来看,我们的探测器比每项任务最强的基准提高3.8%至195.1%,同时保持竞争性的已知等级探测。 在分类方面,我们参考了欧拉图,其中一类区域包含其成员的区域。 我们的分类人员从已知的班级中构建了每个类别所在的区域,并学会了为其成员留下多少从未见过的空间. 在同一探测上,它比现有的分级方法更准确地将未知物体分类. 代码见https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Detectors deployed in the real world may encounter objects outside their annotated training classes. Open-world object detection (OWOD) [ 15 ] aims to localize such objects and label them as unknown , while still recognizing the known classes.
This label, however, treats all unknown objects alike. A broader category such as animal could help an autonomous system anticipate that an unfamiliar zebra may move on its own, unlike a fallen tree.
We therefore argue that an open-world detector should answer three questions about each detection, namely (1) whether it is an object , (2) whether it belongs to a known class and (3) if not, to which broader category it belongs .
blocks.zh:
部署在现实世界的探测器可能在其附加说明的培训课程之外遇到物体。 开放世界对象检测(OWOD)[15]旨在将此类对象定位并标为未知 ,同时仍然识别已知的类.
然而,这一标签对所有未知物体一视同仁。 动物等更广泛的分类可以帮助一个自主的系统预见到不熟悉的斑马会自己移动,这与倒下一棵树不同.
因此,我们主张开放世界的探测器应回答关于每个探测器的三个问题,即(1)它是否是物体;(2)它是否属于已知的类别;(3)如果不属于,它属于哪个更广泛的类别。

blocks.en:
Only question (2) can be learned directly from known-class annotations.
Questions (1) and (3) concern objects of unknown classes, which carry no annotations, so a detector must answer both by generalizing from the known classes.
For question (1), existing OWOD methods generalize, for example, by pseudo-labeling unannotated regions [ 15 , 11 ] or by learning a class-agnostic objectness score from known objects [ 43 ] .
Question (3), which we term unknown object categorization , has been studied mainly in image classification, for example by HND [ 18 ] and ProHOC [ 35 ] .
Most OWOD methods stop at the first two questions, and only a few detectors answer all three [ 42 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
只有问题(2)可以直接从已知的阶级说明中学习.
问题(1)和(3)涉及无说明的未知类对象,因此探测器必须从已知类中概括来回答两者.
对于问题(1),现有的OWOD方法一般化,例如,通过伪标签无注释区域[15,11],或者通过从已知对象中学习出类不可知的物体分数[43].
我们称之为未知物体分类的问题(3)主要在图像分类方面得到研究,例如HND[18]和ProHOC[35]。
大多数OWOD方法止于前两个问题,只有少数探测器回答所有三个[42, 1].

blocks.en:
One might expect that answering question (1) requires better localization of unknown objects.
We find instead that final top- k k selection is the dominant bottleneck in our base detector.
Most unknown objects are already well localized, but their detections are discarded because background receives higher classification scores.
The first part of NEST is therefore a detector built around a class-agnostic ranker trained only on known-class annotations to predict box localization quality [ 14 ] .
Selecting predictions by this quality rather than classification confidence allows well-localized unknown detections to reach the final output.
The second part of NEST , a categorizer for question (3), draws on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a broader category, which we call a group, contains the regions of its members ( Fig. 1 ).
It builds each group’s region in feature space from its known classes, such as dog and giraffe for animal , and learns to leave room for unseen members such as the zebra.
blocks.zh:
人们可能期望,回答问题(1)需要更好地将未知物体本地化。
相反,我们发现,最终的上-克选择是我们基地探测器中的主要瓶颈。
大多数未知物体已经非常本地化,但由于背景获得更高的分级分数,因此其检测被丢弃.
因此,NEST的第一部分是一个探测器,它围绕一个班级不可知级分级器而建造的,它只经过已知的班级说明培训,以预测箱位本地化的质量[14].
用这种质量选择预测,而不是分类自信,可以使本地化的未知检测达到最终输出.
NEST的第二部分是问题(3)的分类法,它借鉴了欧勒图,在这个图中,一个更广泛的类别区域,我们称之为一个集团,包含了其成员的区域(图一.
并学会为斑马等看不见的成员留出空间。

blocks.en:
We evaluate NEST on three OWOD benchmarks.
In M-OWODB [ 15 ] and S-OWODB [ 11 ] , classes within a group are mostly introduced together, leaving nearly all unknown objects with object as their target under our protocol.
We therefore construct R-OWODB by introducing COCO classes [ 22 ] in random order.
Our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection.
On R-OWODB, our categorizer achieves higher accuracy than four hierarchical baselines.
blocks.zh:
我们根据三个组织发展基准来评价国家可持续发展战略。
在M-OWODB [15]和S-OWODB [11]中,一个组内的分级大多是一起引入的,使得几乎所有未知物体都根据我们的协议以物体作为目标.
因此,我们按随机顺序引入COCO类[22]来构建R-OWODB.
我们的探测器比每个任务最强的基线提高了3.8%至195.1%,同时保持竞争性的已知等级探测。
在R-OWODB上,我们的分类器的精确度高于四个等级基线.

blocks.en: In summary, we make three contributions.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们作出了三项贡献。

blocks.en: • We identify final top- k k selection as the dominant bottleneck in our base detector and introduce a class-agnostic ranker that recovers unknown detections using predicted box localization quality. • We propose a categorizer that builds group distributions from their known classes and learns how much to widen them for unseen members. It is detector-agnostic, and other open-world detectors need no retraining to adopt it. • We evaluate NEST on three detection benchmarks and adapt four hierarchical classification methods to compare categorizers on the same detections. The results show higher unknown recall and categorization accuracy with competitive known-class detection.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Open-World Object Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 开放世界物体探测

blocks.en:
OWOD asks a detector to localize objects of classes it was never taught, label them as unknown and learn these classes later once they are annotated [ 15 ] .
Most OWOD methods start from an ImageNet-pretrained backbone and learn unknown detection from task images annotated only for known classes.
Three complementary directions are to mine unknown pseudo-labels, model objectness probabilistically and adapt proposal generation. The first direction trains on pseudo-labels for unannotated regions likely to contain objects.
Candidates are selected using proposal scores [ 15 ] , backbone activation [ 11 ] , activation cues combined with selective search [ 25 ] , hyperbolic similarity to known-class features [ 4 ] or feature dissimilarity to known objects and background [ 27 ] . The second direction models objectness probabilistically.
PROB [ 43 ] uses a Gaussian in query feature space without mining unknown training examples.
Decoupled PROB [ 13 ] estimates objectness at an early decoder layer to reduce interference with class prediction.
OWOBJ [ 40 ] combines probabilistic objectness modeling with pseudo-label supervision, using an adaptive Gaussian prior and converting objectness scores into soft unknown targets for unmatched queries. The third direction changes how the detector generates proposals and represents objects.
RandBox [ 37 ] reduces known-class bias with random proposals, and its extensions OrthogonalDet [ 34 ] and DEUS [ 12 ] further reduce it by disentangling features.
blocks.zh:
OWOD要求一个探测器将其从未教过的课目本地化,标出未知的标签,并在这些课目被注释后稍后学习[15].
大多数的OWOD方法都从一个ImageNet预先训练的骨干开始,从任务图像中学习未知的检测,只为已知的类注释.
三个互补的方向是:地雷未知的伪标签、模型对象概率和适应建议生成。 首个方向列车在伪标签上,用于可能含有物体的无说明区域.
选择候选人时使用建议书分数[15],骨干活化[11],活化提示与选择性搜索相结合[25],双曲与已知类特征相近[4]或特征与已知物体和背景相异[27]. 二取向模型对象概率.
PROB [43] 在查询特征空间中使用高斯人,而不挖掘未知的训练实例.
脱钩后PROB [13] 估计出早期解码层的物体,以减少对类预测的干扰.
OWOBJ [40] 将概率对象模型与伪标签监督结合,使用适应性的高斯前并将对象分数转换为软未知目标,用于无相匹配的查询. 第三个方向改变探测器如何生成建议并代表对象.
RandBox [37] 以随机建议来减少已知的等级偏差,其扩展OrthogonalDet [34]和DEUS [12]通过去除特性来进一步减少偏差.

blocks.en:
Additional pretrained models provide another source of supervision for unknown detection.
MEPU [ 6 ] obtains unknown pseudo-labels from FreeSOLO [ 36 ] , a segmentation model trained without labels on all COCO training images.
SKDF [ 26 ] transfers detections from the vision-language model GLIP [ 20 ] , prompted with the LVIS [ 10 ] class names.
OW-Rep [ 19 ] refines unknown boxes with masks from SAM [ 17 ] and distills features from a vision foundation model into its embeddings.
blocks.zh:
附加的预训型号为未知检测提供了另一个监督来源.
MEPU [6] 从 FreeSOLO [36] 获得未知的假标签,这个分区模型在所有COCO训练图像上都经过了没有标签的培训.
SKDF [26] 从视觉语言模型GLIP [20] 转移检测,由LVIS [10] 类名所激发.
OW-Rep [19]用来自SAM [17] 的口罩来精炼出未知的盒子,并从视觉地基模型中将特征分馏入它的嵌入.

blocks.en:
Some works go one step further and divide the unknown objects into new classes.
They cluster the objects found in a collection of unlabeled images [ 41 , 32 ] , train an extra head that sorts them into a fixed number of clusters [ 7 ] or add a fixed number of unknown classes to an open-world detector [ 38 ] .
Their clusters are anonymous, and a cluster acquires a meaning only when an evaluator matches it to ground-truth classes afterwards.
NEST instead builds on the premise that semantic knowledge learned from known objects can generalize to unknown members of their groups.
It uses this knowledge to assign each unknown object a named taxonomy group, such as animal or furniture .
blocks.zh:
有些作品走得更远,将未知物体分入了新的类.
它们将未加标签的图像集[41,32]中发现的物体集群,将一个额外的头将它们分解成一个固定数的集群[7],或者在开放世界的探测器上添加一个固定数的未知类. [38].
它们的集群是匿名的,一个集群只有在评价者随后将其与地真相类相匹配时才具有意义.
NEST的前提是,从已知物体中学到的语义知识可以概括到其群体中的未知成员。
它利用这种知识为每个未知物体指定一个命名的分类群,例如动物或家具.

blocks.en: 2.2 Open-Vocabulary Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 开放式词汇检测

blocks.en:
Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) also goes beyond a fixed label space, but its setting is different.
An OVD detector receives an image together with a text prompt and localizes the objects that the prompt names [ 39 , 30 , 24 , 2 ] .
Vision-language models such as CLIP [ 31 ] make this possible by embedding images and text in a shared space, so that region features can be matched against the text embeddings of arbitrary class names.
ViLD [ 9 ] distills CLIP image embeddings into the region features of a detector, and GLIP [ 20 ] pretrains a detector to ground prompt phrases in the image.
Since the prompt names the classes, OVD suits targets known in advance, as when a user asks to “find the bottle”.
NEST is an OWOD method, not an OVD method.
It never receives the names of the unknown classes and uses neither prompts nor text embeddings.
blocks.zh:
Open-vobulary检测(OVD)也超越了固定的标签空间,但其设置不同.
OVD 探测器接收到一个图像,加上文字提示并本地化该提示名称的对象[39, 30, 24, 2].
CLIP [31]等视觉语言模型通过将图像和文本嵌入到共享空间中,使得这一点成为可能,这样区域特征就可以与任意类名的文本嵌入相匹配.
ViLD [9] 将 CLIP 图像蒸馏出嵌入到一个探测器的区域特性中,而GLIP [20] 预取一个探测器来将图像中的快取短语放入地.
由于这些分类被及时命名,OVD套装目标事先知道,如用户要求“找到瓶子”。
NEST是一种OWOD方法,而不是OVD方法.
它从未收到未知类的名称,也不使用提示或文字嵌入.

blocks.en: 2.3 Novel Classes in a Class Hierarchy
blocks.zh: 2.3 等级小说类

blocks.en:
Assigning unfamiliar objects to broader nodes in a class hierarchy, such as animal for a zebra, has been studied mainly in image classification.
Most methods choose the node at test time from the scores of classifiers trained on the known classes.
DARTS [ 3 ] maximizes the expected information gain subject to a minimum overall accuracy, HSC [ 23 ] descends the hierarchy while a per-node confidence exceeds a threshold set on known classes, and ProHOC [ 35 ] minimizes the expected tree distance, using novelty scores from separate networks trained at each depth.
HND [ 18 ] instead learns an explicit novel output under every internal node, trained by relabeling images of known classes with an ancestor.
Few detectors give such coarser answers.
Zhou et al . [ 42 ] apply the training of HND to the classification head of a detector on driving datasets.
HSGDet [ 1 ] navigates a WordNet [ 29 ] hierarchy embedded in the CLIP text space to place each unknown object in remote-sensing images under a node.
We evaluate the four classification methods above as categorization baselines on the frozen query features of open-world detectors.
blocks.zh:
将不熟悉的物体分配到一个类分级中的更宽的节点,如为斑马而设的动物,主要在图像分类中被研究.
多数方法在测试时从已知班级训练的分数中选择节点.
DARTS [3] 将预期信息收益最大化,但以最低总体准确度为限,HSC [23] 降级,而每个节点的置信度则会超过为已知分类设定的阈值,而ProHOC [35] 则将预期树距最小化,使用在每个深度训练的不同网络中的新得分.
HND [18]转而在每个内部节点下学习出一个明确的小说出品,通过给已知班级有祖先的图像再贴上标签来训练.
探测器很少给出这样的收缩器答案.
周克等. [42] 将HND培训应用到一个探测器的分类头部关于驱动数据集.
HSGDet [1] 导航嵌入 CLIP 文本空间的 WordNet [29] 分级,将每个未知对象放入遥感图像中置于节点下.
我们评价上述四种分类方法作为开放世界探测器被冻结的查询特征的分类基线。

blocks.en: RandBox. RandBox [ 37 ] builds on Fast R-CNN [ 8 ] with randomly sampled training proposals. It uses the detection head of Sparse R-CNN [ 33 ] to refine proposals over six stages. The final query feature x x feeds a localization head and a class head with one output per known class and an unknown output. Matched queries receive their annotated class labels. For unknown supervision, RandBox ranks proposals by the sum of their sigmoid scores over the known classes and unknown , then assigns unknown pseudo-labels to unmatched queries among the top-ranked proposals. The remaining unmatched queries are treated as background.

We therefore build our detector around a class-agnostic ranker that predicts localization quality to select the final detections.
Unlike the objectness methods of Sec. 2.1 , our detector leaves labeling to the class head and selection to the ranker.

We build the taxonomy 𝒯 \mathcal{T} from COCO [ 22 ] , with the root object , the 12 COCO supercategories as groups and the 80 classes as leaves.
The two standard benchmarks, M-OWODB [ 15 ] and S-OWODB [ 11 ] , introduce the 80 COCO classes over four tasks.
Since both benchmarks introduce most supercategories within a single task, the target a t ​ ( u ) a_{t}(u) is the root object for 90–97% of unknown test objects in M-OWODB Tasks 1–3 and for 100% of them in S-OWODB (Supp. Sec. B ).
We therefore construct R-OWODB, which splits the 80 COCO classes at random into four tasks of 20, so most supercategories are spread over several tasks.
The share of unknown test objects whose target is the root then falls from 54% at Task 1 to 17% at Task 2 and 0% at Task 3.
All three benchmarks follow the protocol of ORE [ 15 ] , in which each task after the first ends with fine-tuning on a small balanced set of images (Supp. Sec. B ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Uncovering Unknown Objects
blocks.zh: 4.1 不明物体的发现

blocks.en:
Following prior work [ 11 , 43 , 34 ] , we report known-class mean average precision (mAP) at an IoU of 0.5 and unknown recall (U-Rec) , the fraction of unknown test objects matched by a prediction labeled unknown at the same IoU .
We build on RandBox [ 37 ] , so RandBox and its extension OrthogonalDet [ 34 ] are our most direct comparisons.
On M-OWODB and S-OWODB, we take all baseline results from their publications, and on R-OWODB, we train RandBox and OrthogonalDet with their official implementations.
blocks.zh:
继先前的工作[11,43,34]之后,我们报告已知等级的平均精度(mAP)在0.5和未知召回(U-Rec)的IoU上,这是不明试验物体的分数,并标注在同一IoU上未知的预测。
我们建立在RandBox [37]上,所以RandBox及其扩展OrthogonalDet [34]是我们最直接的比较.
在M-OWODB和S-OWODB上,我们从它们的出版物中取出所有基线结果,在R-OWODB上,我们用它们的正式执行来训练RandBox和OrthogonalDet.

blocks.en:
Results. Our detector achieves the highest U-Rec across Tasks 1–3 on all three benchmarks, with relative gains of 3.8% to 195.1% over the strongest baseline in each task ( Tab. 1 ).
The gain is smallest on S-OWODB Task 2, where PROB+OWOBJ recalls 28.7% of the unknown test objects against our 29.8%, and largest on R-OWODB Task 1, where OrthogonalDet recalls 14.4% against our 42.5%.
This range comes mainly from the strongest baseline, whose U-Rec varies from 13.2% to 31.9% across tasks, while ours stays between 29.8% and 43.5%.
Part of our gain also comes from spending more of the shared budget (at most 100 predictions per image) on unknown predictions, but with the same number of unknown predictions as each baseline, our detector still recalls 1.2 to 1.6 times as many unknown objects (Supp. Sec. C ).
Known-class detection remains competitive.
On M-OWODB, our detector has the highest mAP in Tasks 1–3 and matches OrthogonalDet in Task 4.
On S-OWODB and R-OWODB, it reaches the highest or joint-highest mAP in three of eight tasks and falls no more than 3.3 points below the best result in the others.
More detailed results, including the absolute open-set error, are in Supp. Sec. C .

blocks.en: 4.2 Nesting Unknown Objects
blocks.zh: 4.2 嵌入未知对象

blocks.en:
We evaluate how well a categorizer assigns unknown objects to their target groups.
A categorizer can only be tested on the unknown objects that its detector finds, so the detector decides what the test covers.
Our detector finds the most unknown objects ( Tab. 1 ), about two to four times as many as RandBox or OrthogonalDet, so we evaluate all categorizers on its R-OWODB detections for the most complete test.
The categorizer assigns a group to the query feature of each prediction labeled unknown , and this group is compared with the target a t ​ ( u ) a_{t}(u) of the unknown test object that the prediction matches one-to-one at an IoU of at least 0.5.
blocks.zh:
我们评价分类人员如何为目标群体分配未知物体。
一个分类器只能被测试在其探测器所发现的未知物体上,因此探测器决定测试覆盖的内容.
我们的探测器发现了最未知的物体(Tab. 1),大约是RandBox或OrthogonalDet的2至4倍,因此我们对其R-OWODB探测器的所有分类器进行评估,以便进行最完整的测试.
分类器为每个被标记为未知的预测的查询特征指定一个组,这个组与未知测试对象的t (u) a_{t} (u) 比较,预测在IoU上匹配至少为0.5的一对一.

blocks.en:
OWOD methods label unknown objects only as unknown , so we adapt the four classification methods of Sec. 2.3 that assign unknown classes to groups, HND [ 18 ] , ProHOC [ 35 ] , HSC [ 23 ] and DARTS [ 3 ] .
Like our categorizer, each learns from the frozen query features of annotated known objects with the same taxonomy, and all five are evaluated on the same matched objects.
We report the mean over three training seeds and give the standard deviations in Supp. Sec. C .
Node-exact measures how often a matched object is assigned to its target group, g ^ = a t ​ ( u ) \hat{g}=a_{t}(u) .
We also report the area under the curve (AUC) to assess the trade-off between correct assignments to coarser and more specific groups as their relative score bias varies, for Tasks 1–2 only, since at Task 3 no unknown class has the root as its target. End-to-end recall (E2E) is the share of all unknown test objects that are matched and assigned to their target group, g ^ = a t ​ ( u ) \hat{g}=a_{t}(u) , so it measures uncovering and nesting together.
blocks.zh:
OWOD方法只将未知物体标为未知物体,所以我们修改了将未知类划为组分的Sec.2.3的四个分类方法,HND [18],ProHOC [35],HSC [23]和DARTS [3].
和我们的分类器一样,每个都学习了同一分类的被注释已知对象的被冻结的查询特性,所有五个都在同一匹配对象上被评价.
我们报告三个以上训练种子的平均值,并给出了Supp中的标准偏差。 C部长.
节点精确度测量对象被分配给目标群体的频率, g^ = a t (u)\hat{g}=a_{t} (u) 。 。 。 。
我们还报告曲线下的区域(AUC),以评估由于相对的分数偏差不同而分配给同龄人和较具体群体的正确任务之间的取舍,仅对任务1至2而言,因为在任务3中,没有未知类别作为其目标。 端到端召回(E2E)是所有未知的试验对象中与其目标群体相匹配并被分配的比例,g^ = a t (u)\hat{g}=a_{t} (u),因此它可以测量发现并一起筑巢.

blocks.en:
Results. Our categorizer achieves the highest Node-exact, AUC and E2E at every task ( Tab. 3 ).
The task sequence changes what this requires.
At Task 1, about half of the unknown classes have the root object as their target, so answering object is often correct and all categorizers reach a Node-exact of 56% to 65%.
From Task 2 on, most unknown classes have a supercategory as their target, and Node-exact drops for every categorizer.
At Task 3, where answering object is never correct, the categorizers differ most.
ProHOC still answers object for most matched objects and reaches only 17.8%, while DARTS rarely answers object but often chooses the wrong supercategory.
Our categorizer has its largest lead here, with 49.5% against 45.4% for HSC, so it chooses the supercategory more accurately than any baseline.
At Tasks 1 and 2, where the target can be either the root or a supercategory, its highest AUC also shows that it judges best how specific an answer should be.
blocks.zh:
结果。 我们的分类器在每个任务上都实现了最高的节点精确,AUC和E2E(Tab. 3.).
任务顺序会改变它所需要的内容.
在"任务一"中,大约一半的未知类有根对象作为其目标,因此应答对象往往是正确的,所有分类者都达到了56%到65%的节点精确度.
从"任务2"开始,大多数未知的类都有一个超类作为其目标,而节点-精确度会为每一个分类者下降.
在任务3中,回答对象永远不对,分类者差异最大.
ProHOC仍然为大多数匹配对象回答对象,并且只达到17.8%,而DARTS很少回答对象,但经常选择错误的超类.
我们的分类器这里的铅含量最大,HSC为49.5%对45.4%,因此它比任何基线更准确地选择了超类.
在任务1和任务2中,目标可以是根,也可以是超级类,其最高的AUC也表明,它最好地判断一个答案应该如何具体.

blocks.en:
Our categorizer needs only one feature vector per detection, making it detector-agnostic.
In Supp. Sec. C , when we also apply it to the features of RandBox or OrthogonalDet, it keeps the highest Node-exact in five of the six cases.

我们的分类器每一次检测只需要一个特性矢量,使其具有探测器-可知性.
在Supp. Sec. (英语). C,当我们也应用到RandBox或OrthogonalDet的特征时,它保持了6个案例中中5个中最高的节点精确.

blocks.en: 5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5 读取研究

blocks.en: We ablate the parts of NEST that uncover unknown objects ( Sec. 5.1 ) and those that nest them in groups ( Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们放弃NEST中发现不明物体的部分(第5.1节)和将物体成群筑巢的部分(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Detector Components
blocks.zh: 5.1 探测器组件

blocks.en:
To test how each part of our detector helps it uncover unknown objects while keeping its known mAP , we add the parts of Sec. 3.2 one at a time and compare the three resulting variants, shown as rows in Fig. 5 .
The first has a class head with outputs for the 20 known classes only.
The second adds the not known output.
The third adds the ranker, which completes our detector.
blocks.zh:
为了测试我们探测器的每个部分如何帮助它发现未知物体,同时保留已知的mAP,我们每次添加3.2 个元件并比较三个产生的变体,如图5中的行所示。
第一个班长只有20个已知班级的产出。
第二增加未知输出.
第三部增加分级器,完成我们的探测器.

blocks.en:
An unknown object can end up in only five places, which follow the order of inference.
For each detector variant, we track which place each of the 15704 unknown objects of the M-OWODB Task 1 test set ends up in.
(I) No query overlaps it with an IoU of at least 0.5.
(II) Every query on it is labeled with a known class.
(III) NMS removes all its detections labeled unknown .
(IV) None of these detections is among the 100 that the image keeps.
(V) One of the 100 overlaps it and is labeled unknown , so the object is found. U-Rec is the share of objects in this last place.
blocks.zh:
未知物体最终只能分出5个位置,这5个位置遵循了推断的顺序.
对于每个探测器变体,我们追踪M-OWODB任务1测试装置中的15704个未知物体的每个位置。
(一)没有查询与至少0.5的IoU重叠.
(二) 上面的每个查询都标有已知的类.
(三) NMS删除所有标有未知标记的检测.
(四) 这些探测器中没有一个是图像保存的100个。
(五)百人之一相重叠并被标签为未知. 因此发现对象. U-Rec 是最后一个位置对象的共享 。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Where the unknown objects end up. Each row splits the 15704 unknown test objects of M-OWODB Task 1 by where one detector loses or finds them, in %. With known classes only, every unknown object that a query reaches gets a known-class label (II). The not known output labels most of them unknown , but their detections fall outside the 100 that each image keeps (IV). Ranking the same detections by one minus their not known probability already finds 37.6%, and our ranker finds 43.5%.
blocks.zh: 图5:未知物体的终点. 每行将 M-OWODB 任务1 的15704 未知测试对象拆分, 以% 为单位。 只有已知的类,每个查询到达的未知对象都会得到已知的类标签(II). 未知的输出标签大多未知 , 但它们的检测值低于每个图像保存的 100 (IV) 。 将同样的探测量 减去未知概率 已经发现37.6%, 我们的排名发现43.5%。

blocks.en:
Without an output for unknown objects, all 67.3% of the unknown objects that a query reaches end up in place (II).
The detector has no other label to give them, so each one is labeled with whichever known class scores highest.
For example, trucks are labeled car in 66% of cases.
The not known output gives these objects a label of their own and shrinks place (II) to 0.4%.
Most of them move to place (IV) instead (61.1%).
Their detections labeled unknown are outranked by background and miss the 100 that each image keeps, so only 0.52% of the unknown objects are found.
A likely reason is that the detector is sure that background belongs to no known class, while an unknown object often looks like a known class, as a zebra looks like a horse.
The detector therefore gives background the higher not known probability, 0.84 against 0.69 for unknown objects at the median.
A natural question is whether simply reversing this ranking helps, and it does.
Ranked by one minus their not known probability, the same detections find 37.6% of the unknown objects (indented row of Fig. 5 ).
When our ranker chooses the 100 instead, 43.5% are found and place (IV) shrinks to 18.7%, while known mAP stays within one point of the known-only detector (62.40 against 63.31).
blocks.zh:
没有未知物体的输出,所有67.3%的查询到达的未知物体最终都到位(II).
探测器没有其他标签可以给他们,所以每个标签上都标有已知最高等级的分数.
例如,卡车在66%的案例中是贴有标签的汽车.
未知输出给这些对象一个自己的标签并缩小位置( 二)到0.4%。
他们大多迁居(四)而迁居(61.1%)。
他们被标记为未知的探测器因背景而名列前茅并错过了每个图像所保存的100个,因此只发现了0.52%的未知物体.
一个可能的原因是,探测器确定背景属于没有已知的类,而一个未知的物体往往看起来像一个已知的类,而斑马看起来像一匹马.
因此,探测器给背景提供了较高的未知概率,中位点不明物体的概率为0.84比0.69.
一个自然的问题是,仅仅扭转这种排名是否有帮助,而且确实有用。
同样的探测器以一相倒减其未知概率,发现了37.6%的未知物体(缩入行图5 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Categorizer Components
blocks.zh: 5.2 分类器组件

blocks.en: We ablate the cut loss and the widening Δ g \Delta_{g} of the categorizer of Sec. 3.3 on R-OWODB ( Tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们减少在R-OWODB(TB. 4)上的3.3塞克分类器的被削减损失和不断扩大的QQ g\Delta_{g]。

blocks.en:
Without the cut loss, the categorizer learns only from the known-class loss, which asks each known object to score its own class above all other classes and groups.
A group thus appears in training only as a rival that must lose, and the groups lose most easily by spreading their Gaussians, at Task 1 to ten times the variance of the known classes they contain, against 3.6 times in the full model.
A spread Gaussian gives a low score everywhere, while the root’s mixture also holds the known classes directly under it, whose Gaussians stay narrower.
At Task 1, with seven such classes, the categorizer therefore answers object for 99.5% of the objects whose target is a group.
At Tasks 2 and 3, with three and one such classes, it answers object for only 1.7% and 0.4% of them, but piles them onto single groups, sending 26% and 29% to furniture and indoor , which are the targets of only 6% and 10%.
blocks.zh:
没有被削减的损失,分类者只从已知的类损失中学习,这要求每个已知的物体将自己的类分数高于其他所有类和组.
因此,一个团体在训练中只作为必须输掉的对手出现,这些团体通过传播高斯人最容易输掉,在任务1中,他们包含的已知班级的差异为10倍,而在全模式中则为3.6倍.
分布在各地的高斯人给出了较低的分数,而根的混合物也把已知的等级直接放在下方,而高斯人则保持更窄.
在任务1中,有7个这样的类,分类者因此对目标为一组的99.5%的对象进行解答.
在任务2和任务3中,有3个和1个这样的类别,它只回答1.7%和0.4%的反对,但把它们堆成单组,将26%和29%送到家具和室内,而目标仅为6%和10%。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Categorizer ablation on R-OWODB with our detector. Node-exact (NE) and AUC in %, averaged over three seeds, with standard deviations of at most 0.67 except 2.11 for the AUC without the cut loss at Task 1. Removing either the cut loss or the increment Δ g \Delta_{g} lowers every score.
blocks.zh: 表4:R-OWODB上用探测器进行分类。 节点精确(NE)和AUC以%为单位,平均有3个种子,标准偏差最多为0.67分,但AUC的2.11分除外,没有在"任务1"被削减损失. 切除损失或增量 \ g\ Delta\ g} 降低每个分数 。

blocks.en:
Without the increments Δ g \Delta_{g} , each group is made of its members’ own narrow Gaussians and scores high only right next to a known member.
The root, however, still covers each group with one wide Gaussian spanning all its members ( Eq. 3 ).
A new member that is not right next to a known member therefore goes to object , as do 49.8% and 29.8% of the objects whose target is a group at Tasks 2 and 3, against 9.8% and 1.9% in the full model, and Node-exact falls by 5.32 and 12.01 points.
At Task 1, groups hold at most four members instead of up to seven and eight, so the root’s Gaussians cover less extra space, and Node-exact drops by only 0.78.
blocks.zh:
没有增量 每一组都是由其成员自己狭隘的高斯人组成,
然而,根仍涵盖每个群体,一个宽阔的高斯人横跨其所有成员(第3段)。
因此,不与已知成员相邻的新成员会表示反对,目标为任务2和3组的物体的49.8%和29.8%也表示反对,而完整模型中的9.8%和1.9%为对象,节点精确度则下降5.32%和12.01分。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Open-world detectors find too few unknown objects and say nothing about what they are.
NEST addresses both problems with two components: a class-agnostic ranker that uncovers unknown objects and a detector-agnostic categorizer that nests them in the groups of a class taxonomy.
Both learn from the known classes alone.
For uncovering, we show that most unknown objects are not missed by the detector but discarded in its final selection, because the not known label mixes them with background.
By judging how well each prediction fits an object, the ranker recovers most of them and gives the highest U-Rec in every task of three benchmarks.
For nesting, the categorizer builds each group as a region in feature space that contains its known classes and learns how much room to leave for unseen members.
On our detector, it assigns unknown objects to their target groups more often than four hierarchical classification methods at every task.
With NEST, the unknown objects that a detector already localizes no longer have to be discarded or left only as unknown .
blocks.zh:
开放世界的探测器发现的未知物体太少,对它们是什么却一言不发.
NEST用两个组成部分解决这两个问题:一个是发现未知物体的可知级分级器,另一个是将它们嵌入分类群中的可知级分级器。
两人单独向已知的班级学习.
为了发现,我们显示,大多数未知物体不会被探测器错过,而是在最后的选择中被丢弃,因为未知的标签将它们与背景相混合.
通过判断每个预测是否适合一个对象,分级器会收回其中的大部分,并在三项基准的每一项任务中给出最高的U-Rec.
对于筑巢,分类者将每个群体建设成一个区域,其特征空间包含已知的类,并学习为看不见的成员留下多少空间.
在我们的探测器上,它为目标群体分配的未知物体在每项任务中往往超过四种等级分类方法。
在 NEST 中, 探测器已经定位的未知对象不再需要被丢弃, 或只留下未知的 。

Choosing τ \tau . Across benchmarks and tasks, 95% to 99% of the training queries receive the not known target.

Because τ \tau affects both known mean average precision (mAP) and unknown recall (U-Rec) , it should ideally be chosen on a validation set in which both known and unknown objects are annotated.
However, the open-world object detection (OWOD) benchmarks have no such validation set, and choosing τ \tau on the test set would tune it to the test data.
A natural alternative is to hold out part of the training images, but this does not solve the problem.

Choosing η \eta . The ranker loss of Eq. 1 covers only the predicted boxes whose intersection over union (IoU) with an annotated object exceeds η \eta .
The threshold thus decides which predictions the ranker learns from.
We choose it on the same validation set as τ \tau .
In Tab. A2 , η = 0.3 \eta=0.3 reaches both the highest known mAP and the highest U-Rec . Figure A2 shows why.
For each η \eta , it plots the median ranker score of three types of predictions on the validation images. Boxes on unknown objects overlap an unknown object with an IoU above 0.5. Loose boxes overlap a known or unknown object only partly, with a best IoU between 0.1 and 0.5. Background boxes overlap no known or unknown object with an IoU above 0.1.
Boxes on unknown objects compete with loose boxes and background boxes for the 100 places that each image keeps.
At a low η \eta , loose boxes are the stronger competitor.

At a high η \eta , background boxes are the stronger competitor.

We use η = 0.3 \eta=0.3 for all tasks and benchmarks.

blocks.en:
Under the retention rule of Sec. 3.3 , at least 90% of the unknown test objects at Tasks 1–3 of M-OWODB and S-OWODB have the root object as their target.
On R-OWODB, this share falls from 54.2% at Task 1 to 17.1% at Task 2 and 0% at Task 3 (Root column of Tab. B1 ).
The difference between the benchmarks comes from the order in which they introduce the classes of each COCO supercategory.
S-OWODB introduces each supercategory within one task, and M-OWODB does the same after the 20 PASCAL VOC classes of Task 1.
The unknown classes of such a supercategory always target the root, since none of its classes is known before that task.
R-OWODB instead shuffles the 80 COCO classes once with a random seed and splits them into four tasks of 20, so most supercategories are spread over several tasks.

blocks.en:
Baselines. As in Sec. 4.1 , RandBox [ 37 ] and its extension OrthogonalDet [ 34 ] are our most direct comparisons, since we build on RandBox.
On R-OWODB, we train both with their official implementations on the same class partition and task sequence as our detector, with the schedule of Tab. A1 .
On M-OWODB and S-OWODB, we take all baseline results from the corresponding publications.
For a broader comparison on these two benchmarks, we add the DETR-based methods OW-DETR [ 11 ] , PROB [ 43 ] , CAT [ 25 ] , Hyp-OW [ 4 ] , Decoupled PROB [ 13 ] and PROB+OWOBJ [ 40 ] and, on M-OWODB, the Faster R-CNN-based UC-OWOD [ 38 ] .

blocks.en:
We leave out two other recent OWOD methods, CROWD [ 27 ] and DEUS [ 12 ] , because they keep a varying number of predictions per image.
Predictions that overlap no annotated object do NOT lower U-Rec , so in the extreme case, labeling a dense grid of boxes as unknown would find almost every unknown object .
Like most OWOD methods, our detector keeps 100 predictions per image, chosen by its ranker, while the public code of CROWD keeps every prediction that survives non-maximum suppression (NMS) and a score threshold, up to 10000 per image.
DEUS has no public code, but its supplementary material describes the same kind of selection as CROWD.

我们省略了另外两种最近的OWOD方法,CROWD[27]和DEUS[12],因为它们每个图像的预测量各不相同.

blocks.en:
Baselines. To compare fairly, all five categorizers learn from the same annotated known objects, and none of the baselines is tuned on unknown objects.
The known objects come from the 75650 training images at Task 1 and from the 1588 and 2378 fine-tuning images at Tasks 2 and 3.
Each categorizer trains on a random 90% of these images, and the other 10% serve as validation images.
HND [ 18 ] , ProHOC [ 35 ] , HSC [ 23 ] and DARTS [ 3 ] follow their released recipes.
ProHOC keeps the epoch with the highest validation accuracy and decides by the expected tree distance.
HSC trains with the two loss settings of its released code and keeps the one with the higher validation accuracy.
DARTS chooses the regularization of its linear support vector machines (SVMs) by validation accuracy and sets its trade-off between accuracy and specificity to guarantee 90% accuracy on the validation images.
The same training applies to the features of RandBox and OrthogonalDet.
blocks.zh:
基线。 为了进行公平的比较,所有五个分类者都从同一个被注解的已知物体中学习,没有一个基线是针对未知物体的.
已知物体出自"任务1"的75650训练图像和"任务2"和"任务3"的1588和2378微调图像.
每个分类器列车在90%的这些图像上随机运行,其他10%作为验证图像.
HND [18], ProHOC [35], HSC [23]和DARTS [3] 遵循他们发布的食谱.
ProHOC以最高的验证精确度保持了纪元并按预期的树距来决定.
HSC列车带有其已放出代码的两种损失设置,并保持了更高的验证精度.
DARTS通过验证精度选择其线性支持向量机(SVM)的正则化,并设定其精度和特异性之间的取舍,以保证验证图像的精度达到90%.
同样的培训也适用于RandBox和OrthogonalDet的特征.

blocks.en:
Metrics. In the COCO taxonomy, groups exist at only two levels, the root and the retained supercategories, so the area under the curve (AUC) measures the trade-off between them.
Every categorizer scores the root and each retained supercategory for a matched object.
For a baseline, these scores are the values that its own decision rule compares, such as the novel outputs of HND.
We add an offset to the root score and assign the root when this sum is at least the highest supercategory score.
As the offset rises from − ∞ -\infty to + ∞ +\infty , the share of root-target objects assigned to the root rises from 0 to 1, and the share of supercategory-target objects assigned to their target falls to 0.
The AUC is the area under the curve of the second share against the first.
At a zero offset, each categorizer makes its own assignments, on which Node-exact is measured. End-to-end recall (E2E) counts the same correct assignments but divides them by all unknown test objects of the task instead of the matched ones, so an object that the detector misses counts as an error.
Node-exact and AUC therefore compare categorizers only on the matched objects of one detector, while E2E also compares across detectors, and all three are computed for each unknown class and then averaged over the classes.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 在COCO分类学中,组只存在于两个层次上,根和所保留的超类,因此曲线下的区域(AUC)测量它们之间的取舍.
每个分类者给根打分,每个分类者为匹配对象保留了超类.
对于基线来说,这些分数是其自身决策规则所比较的数值,例如HND的新产出.
我们给根分数加一个偏移,并在这个和数至少是最高的超类分数时指定根.
随着相抵从------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AUC是第二股对一股的曲线下的区域.
在零偏移时,每个分类者都会自己做出任务,以此来衡量节点-精确度. 端到端召回(E2E)计算出相同的正确任务,但将其除以任务中所有未知的测试对象而不是相匹配的测试对象,因此一个被检测器错失的对象算作错误.
因此,节点精确和AUC只比较一个探测器的对应物体的分类器,而E2E也比较了各种探测器,所有三种都按每个未知的类别计算,然后按各类别进行平均值.

blocks.en:
Part (b) compares the groups that the five categorizers assign to the same detection from our detector.
At Task 3, no unknown class has the root object as its target.
Nevertheless, HND answers object for the tennis racket, the bus and the horse, and ProHOC for the racket, the bus, the two ovens, the baseball bat and the orange.
ProHOC answers object this often because it chooses the group with the smallest expected tree distance.
With groups at only two levels, this group is a supercategory only when the supercategory and its classes hold more than half of the predicted probability, which no supercategory reaches for these objects.
DARTS makes a different mistake.
It rarely answers object but assigns an object to the supercategory of the known class it resembles most.
For the racket, this is the backpack, with 84% of the probability, so DARTS answers accessory , as it does for the oven in the second row.
Our categorizer and HSC, in contrast, assign these objects to their target groups, such as sports for the racket and appliance for the ovens, in line with their leading performance in Tab. 3 .
